Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

nlmixr2llm 0.1.0

  • Initial version.
  • Ships a single combined nlmixr2verse agent spanning the nlmixr2 pharmacometrics ecosystem (rxode2, nlmixr2, nonmem2rx, monolix2rx, babelmixr2), plus one skill per package.
  • Accessor functions: list_packages(), list_agents(), list_skills(), get_agent(), get_skill(), and system_prompt() for use as a system prompt with any LLM client.
  • Installer functions write the content into the locations expected by Claude Code (install_claude_code()), OpenAI Codex CLI (install_codex()), Positron Assistant (install_positron()), and any tool that reads AGENTS.md (install_agents_md()). Multi-file installers track what they write in a manifest and can prune content the package no longer ships.
  • nlmixr2llm_status() reports whether the content installed into each target is up to date with the package.

Developed by John Harrold.
